submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness achieves the best energy resolution of 3.166% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents a significant improvement over the baseline 5 mm configuration (3.2%) and substantially outperforms both F1 (best: 5.1% at 5mm) and F3 (best: 3.9% at 5mm) across all tested thicknesses. The systematic scan of F2 across multiple thicknesses (2, 4, 5, 6, 8, and 10 mm) confirms that 4 mm is optimal, with resolution degrading at both smaller (3.479% at 2mm) and larger (3.402% at 6mm, 3.694% at 8mm, 4.721% at 10mm) thicknesses. All three candidate materials pass the critical radiation safety constraint of 20 μSv/h dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown, making this selection based purely on performance optimization. The 4 mm thickness also falls well within the specified 2-10 mm constraint range.
